charges_and_operator_space.included_fields: The two original source singlets eta,s and one ordinary adjoint A per sector; one heavy triplet bilinear. No mediator fields or higher operators counted.
charges_and_operator_space.ordinary_phase_charge_implication: constant heavy mass + Higgs ordinary Yukawa + same-source mixing + same-source heavy Yukawa imply Higgs-heavy Yukawa allowed
charges_and_operator_space.quadratic_source_decomposition: 2 singlets plus one ordinary 8: singlet multiplicity 4, ordinary 8 multiplicity 3
charges_and_operator_space.reason_for_doubling: Either same-sector quadratic or opposite-sector quadratic is even under both shaping signs. Mixed up-down degree-two products are forbidden.
charges_and_operator_space.same_source_scope: At this degree the same-source heavy mass commutes with C=z I+g A; all adjoint off-diagonal derivatives have a real common divided-difference factor.

exact_hierarchy.scope: Constructive hierarchy with explicit source and coefficient inputs; no measured mass or mixing prediction.

exact_scalar_running_tensor.derivation: Cross term of beta V=(1/32 pi^2)Tr[(H_V+H_insertion)^2] on the canonical eight real Au coordinates; external fermion bilinear treated as a single insertion.
exact_scalar_running_tensor.same_source_dimension5_insertion: kappa bar(U_up,L) Au**2 U_up,R / Lambda + h.c.
exact_scalar_running_tensor.scope: Exact one-loop scalar mixing tensor, not the complete dimension5 anomalous dimension including fermion and gauge diagrams.

exact_source_multiplicities.CP_even_witness: All seven independent displayed matrix contractions are CP covariant with real coefficients, saturating the unitary count.

exact_wrong_source_resolvent.scope: Exact real resolvent-kernel termwise-protection counterexample; the physical B0 threshold is computed separately.

fixed_spectrum_orientation.scope: Relative source eigenframes vary; all six fermion masses in each sector and their doublet weights remain fixed. This is freedom, not a scalar-vacuum or CKM prediction.

functional_benchmark.scope: Neutral-scalar first-order determinant phase and Hermitian seagull reality; full gauge/Yukawa EFT running and higher-loop phases are not computed.

independent_high_precision_threshold.method: Direct Hermitian DDdagger functional calculus in the weak basis; no numpy Dirac SVD.

wrong_source_threshold.scope: Positive finite spectral counterexample for a permitted wrong-source operator and real scalar mixing; not a solved complete invariant scalar vacuum or all-diagram theta calculation.
